effort_levels.1: Catalogued: status and a literature number
effort_levels.4: Geant4 study: full-apparatus simulation, write-up and slides

log.text: LNL target designs in Geant4 (run L10, both detectors, 1.03/1.10 MeV): the 45° diamond window reaches 3σ at the ATOMKI ratio in 0.27 d per µA (big plastics; σ68 9.1°), Pierfrancesco's 200 µm Cu hemisphere in 2.4 d (σ68 22°, external conversion in the Cu is half the background). DREAM copes with the single-arm trigger prescaled; even the big plastics do not saturate. New: the window's Mo K x-rays load the Micromegas; fluorine at the Li/backing interface sits on the 872 keV resonance at 1.10 MeV.

LNL: Pierfrancesco's photographed beam line modelled inside the arms (3D page; ray-trace on the Geant4 legs, est.). The target stays at the detector centre; no accepted lepton crosses the steel tube, valve, tees or flanges (the nearest steel is ~17 cm back); the Cu cup itself costs 9° of σ68, the grey flange 0.2°. A Ø20 diamond window in thin Ti rings matches the design (0.21 d/µA) and is safe at 1 bar. The floor stand clashes with the bottom arm.

LNL target, Pierfrancesco's two shapes (ray-trace on the Geant4 legs, est.): a 200 µm Cu dome puts ≥ 1.4 % X₀ on every lepton (σ68 ~14°, 0.40 vs 0.22 d/µA); Be or Al + Mo domes match the design. The 45°-tilted diamond end window matches it (0.21 d/µA) if the last ~40 mm of tube is thin Al/CFRP, not steel. The LN₂ trap goes upstream, not around the target.

LNL target, Pierfrancesco follow-ups: Geant4 of Li on Cu substrates. A 25 µm Cu foil matches the diamond design (0.21 vs 0.22 d/µA) but caps the current at ~5 µA and blisters in 1–3 weeks; machined Cu ≥ 100 µm costs ×1.6–1.9. The Li stays thin (20 µm) and the beam stops in the backing: a stopping-thick Li film is 77 % 441 keV.

LNL target design page (interactive): Li 20 µm / Mo 8 µm / CVD diamond 50–100 µm, built up layer by layer; no water needed at LNL (a Cu arm to the flange keeps the film at 56 °C at 4 µA); open questions, answers to Pierfrancesco, dropped ideas.

LNL target options (after Pierfrancesco): 20 µm metallic Li gives ×8 the ⁸Be rate per proton; a diamond backing keeps it below 150 °C to ~270 µA (dry clamp); no backing line reaches the 13–18 MeV window; Geant4 L9 of the target assembly. Open: H blistering and Li adhesion on diamond, residual water.

Headline metric is now days of beam to the ATOMKI strength (3σ, statistics only): it sizes the map markers and orders the ranking and the table. The reach is quoted for a 2-week run (the write-ups keep 50 days, one ILL cycle). Studied = blue centre and black ring.

AMANDE (ASNR Cadarache) added: the strongest mono-energetic lab field found (5.9e8 n/s, Ti-T 2 MeV) is still ~260 d to 3σ on the capsule (TARGET); it is a proton-route candidate instead. "Studied" is now a ring around the dot, not a verdict: ILL PF1B and GANIL/NFS are MARGINAL, n_TOF EAR2 is DUTY, Demokritos is TARGET.

LNL lithium target study: the LNL 2023–24 ⁸Be run used LiF at 1.03 MeV, where ¹⁹F makes 2.5–3.5×10³ E0 pairs per ⁸Be pair (the overload ATOMKI/Hanoi warned of); strip targets run at 400–700 °C per µA. MX17 spec: Li₂O on a cooled clamped disk; its 3D fit is unbiased (< 0.06 R_ATOMKI) by a drifting target.

Three more dedicated studies on the shared Geant4 soft-beam background: FRANZ 3.3e-4 at its design 20 mA DC (ties Birmingham; licence 5 % duty 2.2e-3; 2 MeV not yet reported), NPI Řež ⁹Be(p,n) 18 MeV 8.7e-4 (DREAM-limited by fast neutrons), LANSCE WNR 4FP90L at 10 m 8.4e-4 (ToF, statistics-limited; operating).
FRM II MEDAPP and Birmingham HF-ADNeF: dedicated studies with their own Geant4 soft-beam background. Both pass ATOMKI in 50 d: MEDAPP 4.2e-4 (reactor off), Birmingham 3.3e-4 (needs a shielded port).
Days to the ATOMKI strength added beside the 50-day reach: days = 50 × (reach / 1.5e-3)², statistics only.
Dashboard started: 59 catalogue rows, crude X17/day for each, effort levels.
World survey: thermal class closed by the rate walls, pulsed white sources by duty; FRM II MEDAPP and Birmingham HF-ADNeF on the potential list.
GANIL/NFS: Geant4 reach with beam backgrounds, ×2.2 short of ATOMKI (all E*).
Demokritos: neutron beams on ³He closed (34 years to 3σ); proton route Geant4.
LNL proton route: ATOMKI ratio at 3σ in ~8 days at 1 µA (Geant4).
ILL PF1B: Geant4 verdict, ×3.2 short of the ⁸Be level per 50-day cycle.

facilities.next: Proton route, Geant4 (L10, 27 Oct) favours the window: the 45° Ø20 diamond window (200–300 µm, Ti rings, Mo 8 µm) gives 0.27 d/µA (≈ 0.21 on a wide adapter instead of its Ø20 end piece) (big plastics), Pierfrancesco's Cu hemisphere 2.4 d/µA (every lepton crosses the shell; EPC 46 % of B): build the window. DREAM copes with the single-arm output prescaled (P 5–10 at 1 µA); the scintillators do not saturate (478 keV below threshold). Watch the window's Mo K x-rays in the MM (16 %/arm/µA, est.) and fluorine at the Li/stop interface at 1.10 MeV. Ask the grey flange material and how the Mo is cleaned; bench-test H blistering and Li adhesion.
